_readme: Registry of every Figma node, variable and style ID this programme created. Update it after every use_figma create/edit. Your context will be compacted — THIS FILE is the truth, not your memory. At the start of every session, get_metadata the file and confirm these IDs still resolve; if one is missing, STOP and ask the owner. Never silently recreate a node: a human may have moved or deleted it on purpose.

pages._comment: Canonical page set. Tokens-only scope needs just Cover and Foundations — delete the rest and say so in GROUND-TRUTH §7.

variableCollections._comment: One entry per collection. `source` cites the code file the values came from — a collection with no source is a collection someone typed by hand.

variableKeyIndex._note: token name in Figma -> variable key. Written at creation; used for every later bind so nothing gets bound by name lookup at draw time.

_namedVersionsNote: saveVersionHistoryAsync is not available through the MCP plugin API. A human names the version in the Figma UI at each phase checkpoint. Recovery is this registry plus the checklist, not version history.
_logNote: Append-only. Record discoveries and mistakes, not just successes — the log is how the next session learns what already failed.
